sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Montreal Protocol (1987)**: Adopted under the **Vienna Convention** to phase out ODS like **CFCs** and **Halons**. It is the only UN treaty ratified by every country on Earth (Universal Ratification).
• **Kigali Amendment (2016)**: An amendment to the Montreal Protocol to phase down **HFCs** (Hydrofluorocarbons). While HFCs do not deplete the ozone, they are potent **Greenhouse Gases (GHGs)**.
• **Common but Differentiated Responsibilities (CBDR)**: The protocol uses a 'start-and-strengthen' approach, providing financial and technical assistance to **Article 5 countries** (developing nations).
• **Multilateral Fund (MLF)**: The financial mechanism established to help developing countries meet their compliance obligations.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Phase-out vs Phase-down**: Montreal Protocol mandates 'phase-out' (total elimination) of ODS; Kigali mandates 'phase-down' (gradual reduction) of HFCs.
• **India's Role**: India is a signatory and has a national strategy for the phase-out of HCFCs (HPMP - HCFC Phase-out Management Plan).

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Illegal trade in ODS, high cost of HFC alternatives, and energy efficiency in cooling sectors.
• **Solutions**: Adoption of natural refrigerants (Ammonia, CO2) and the 'Cooling Action Plan' (India's ICAP).

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'K-H-G' (Kigali-HFCs-Global Warming).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Kigali Amendment targets HFCs to stop Global Warming, distinct from the original Montreal focus on Ozone holes.

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses 'Ozone Depletion' with 'Global Warming'. Remember: Montreal Protocol (Ozone) + Kigali Amendment (Climate Change/HFCs).
Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Synergistic Governance' to describe how the Montreal Protocol framework is now being used to address climate change via the Kigali Amendment.

keyTakeaways: Montreal Protocol is the most successful environmental treaty with universal ratification.
Kigali Amendment is legally binding and aims to prevent 0.5°C of global warming by 2100.
The Multilateral Fund is the primary financial mechanism for developing nations.
